livePreview.comparisonToTodoist: Todoist's Edit filter dialog also carries a live preview — this sub-clause MATCHES.

tierLimit.todoistState: Used: 3/3 filters, 'Unlock more filters' button present, existing filters: Assigned to me / Priority 1 / All my Routines
tierLimit.consequence: No disposable filter could be created in Todoist, so Todoist's create/rename/recolour/delete were never driven and its DELETE WORDING REMAINS UNCAPTURED.
tierLimit.whyNotWorkedAround: Deleting or renaming one of the user's three real filters is destructive to real data, and the cap forbids a fourth. This is the same refusal the Deadline and Duration rows already carry.

editSurfaceShape.todoist: modal dialog: Name textbox (10/60, prefilled), Color combobox, 'Add to favorites' checkbox, Query textarea (10/1024, prefilled 'priority 1'), live preview
editSurfaceShape.meologue: full-page route: colour select, name input (no counter), query textarea (no counter), live result list, Save / Remove Filter
editSurfaceShape.verdict: DIVERGENT BY SHAPE — modal versus route; no character counters; no favourites checkbox (filter-types.ts carries no favourite field).

whatIsTwoSided.livePreview: MATCH — both show matching results as the query is edited.
whatIsTwoSided.capabilityParity: MATCH — all four operations are reachable in both apps; only Todoist's execution of them was blocked by tier.

comparisonToTodoist.meologueDeleteWordingNote: meologue's 'Remove this Filter?' / 'Remove' does not follow the corpus's 'Delete X? The <name> X will be permanently deleted.' / 'Delete' pattern that meologue's own label and project dialogs do follow. Whether that is a divergence cannot be settled live while the cap stands, so it is recorded, not judged.
